title: Bingeworthy Shows Right Now
intro: The nights are getting longer and so are your watchlists. These are the shows that rewire your brain and refuse to let go.

films.title: Severance
films.line: A workplace so suffocating it splits your sense of self completely in two.

films.title: Dark
films.line: Four families, four timelines, and a knot of fate you will obsessively unravel.

films.title: The Leftovers
films.line: Grief becomes its own religion when two percent of the world simply vanishes.

films.title: The Outsider
films.line: An ironclad alibi and damning evidence exist at the same time for the same crime.
